code: import { ChevronRightIcon } from "lucide-react" import { TextLoop } from "@/components/ui/text-loop" const announcements = [ { tag: "新功能", text: "审批流模板市场正式上线" }, { tag: "优化", text: "报表导出速度提升 3 倍" }, { tag: "安全", text: "已支持企业单点登录（SSO）" }, { tag: "公告", text: "10 月 2 日凌晨进行例行维护" }, ] export default function TextLoopBadges() { return ( {announcements.map((item) => ( {item.tag} {item.text} ))} ) }
